bee.v1.IssueFieldKind.description: Value type of a custom issue field.
bee.v1.IssueFieldKind.title: bee.v1.IssueFieldKind

bee.v1.IssueFieldValue.description:
A field value on an issue. Exactly one value matching the field's kind is set.

Oneof `value`: at most one of `text`, `number`, `dateOn`, `optionId`, `iterationId` is set.

fieldName.description: filled by the server; may be used instead of id on input

bee.v1.IssueFieldValue.title: bee.v1.IssueFieldValue

bee.v1.IssueRef.description: Names an issue by id, or by repo and number. Used for cross-repo relations.
bee.v1.IssueRef.title: bee.v1.IssueRef

bee.v1.KeyValue.description: A key/value pair with a string value (metadata, custom properties, variables).
bee.v1.KeyValue.title: bee.v1.KeyValue

bee.v1.RepoRef.description:
Every repo-scoped request names its repo by id or by "org/name".

Oneof `repo`: at most one of `id`, `fullName` is set.
bee.v1.RepoRef.title: bee.v1.RepoRef

assignees.description: principal ids or handles; agents allowed

formResponses.description: form field id -> answer; rendered into the body

inspiredByPostId.description:
A published post the caller can read that inspired this issue; else INVALID_ARGUMENT
(subcode `post_not_readable`).

issueType.description: type name or id; empty = none

parent.description: optional parent for a new sub-issue

projectIds.description: projects to add the new issue to

template.description: template file name the issue was filed from
